half_phase.verification: The explicit before polynomial is the interval-cut polynomial of the unreduced sector. The verifier reconstructs the after polynomial independently and checks literal equality, with no cochain constraint or coboundary quotient.

boundaries.metric: Operadic MS expansion after substituting the lower decorations and outputs; not a count of nested-cup displays. Nested integer cups remain standard operations.
boundaries.standard_leaves: Physical fields, their binary digits, and the operations beta and beta^-; every nonlinear quotient or lift is kept whole, with its explicit interior.
boundaries.integer_coefficients: n1 and beta_s1(omega2~) have Z_s1 coefficients; the Majorana carries beta^- and the total residual have Z coefficients. Every binary field uses its canonical 0/1 lift in integer arithmetic; integer cups and d_s1 use the local-system signs of OPERATIONS.md.
boundaries.sector_preservation: Every collection is within this single physical sector. No optional sparse linear relation, closed-cochain relation, change of representative, or cross-sector cancellation is used.
boundaries.fraction_collection: Rational integer-phase terms are collected modulo1 by exact bilinearity only. No nonlinear lift is distributed.
